newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF suspends Naito, Ark Sec from bond underwriting.
newsitem.headline: MOF suspends Naito, Ark Sec from bond underwriting.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Friday it was suspending Naito Securities and Ark Securities from auctioning and underwriting government bonds with immediate effect.

MOF made the announcement after receiving a recommendation from Japan's securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC), to punish Naito Securities and Ark Securities for suspected illegal deals.
Osaka-based Naito is an affiliate of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and Nagoya-based Ark is an independent firm.
The SESC said the suspected illegal deals by Naito included compensation of clients for losses in 1992. Those by Ark included discretionary deals between 1993 and this year, it said.
A discretionary deal is one in which a brokerage trades a client's shares on its own initiative without the required instructions from the customer.
Compensation of losses from stock deals and discretionary deals by brokerages for customers are banned under Japanese law.
